description: Approve publication of the exact draft revision on behalf of the company and accept the Listing Terms (LT-2, https://agentcompanyindex.com/legal/listing-terms/lt-2) for it. Requires a verified domain. Before calling: show the user the draft, then the listing_terms summary and link from get_listing_status, and ask whether they may act for the company, approve this exact revision and accept the Listing Terms on the company's behalf. Call only after an explicit yes from that person; never on your own. Pass the approver's full name, role and the company's legal name. When the domain was confirmed with a DNS record or a file, also pass approver_email (an address on the company domain the approver reads): ACI mails it a confirmation link and publication waits for it. The approved revision is then published automatically, usually within minutes; the approver gets an email record of the approval and the terms. When the domain was confirmed with the emailed code, ACI sends a free monthly report (which AI assistants and systems retrieved the profile) to that address; set monthly_report to false if the user does not want it. Every report has an unsubscribe link.

accept_listing_terms.description: Set to "LT-2" only after the user explicitly accepted the Listing Terms (https://agentcompanyindex.com/legal/listing-terms/lt-2) on behalf of the company.

approver_email.description: Required when the domain was confirmed with a DNS record or a file: an address on the company domain the approver reads. Ignored when the domain was confirmed with the emailed code (that address is recorded).

approver_name.description: Full name of the person approving for the company.

company_legal_name.description: The company's legal name (e.g. from its imprint), the party accepting the Listing Terms.

monthly_report.description: Send the monthly report to the confirmed work address (default true).

user_confirmation.description: Optional: the user's reply agreeing to approve and to the Listing Terms, quoted word for word.

name: approve_listing
title: Approve listing draft
